rationale: Sharon and Sankeerth are both building in the AI agent infrastructure space—Sharon as a Partner at TheAgentic.Ai focused on production-ready agents for biotech, healthtech, and fintech, and Sankeerth as CEO of Agentin AI (YC) bringing ML research rigor and enterprise deployment experience from Google. Sharon's background in developer tooling combined with Sankeerth's conviction around practical agentic AI applications and his technical depth in ML create a natural fit for exploring how infrastructure and research intersect in making agents real-world deployable.
intro_message: Sharon, meet Sankeerth Rao Karingula—you're both operating at the core of production AI agent infrastructure, and your complementary strengths in tooling, research, and vertical deployment could spark something valuable.
